data.title: School closed tomorrow due to heavy rain
data.body: Following the weather advisory, the school will remain closed tomorrow. Online worksheets will be shared by class teachers. Classes resume the day after.

data.title: Annual Day rehearsal schedule
data.body: Rehearsals for the Annual Day programme begin next week after school (3:30–5:00 pm). Participating students will receive their group lists from class teachers. Please ensure safe transport home.

data.title: Grade 6 A: science project submission
data.body: Please submit your science project charts and models by Friday. Projects will be displayed in the corridor exhibition. Label every item with name and roll number.

data.title: Updated code of conduct and bus safety policy
data.body: The school has updated its code of conduct and school-bus safety policy for this year. Please read the attached summary with your child and acknowledge in the app. Acknowledgement is required for transport and extracurricular participation.

data.title: Library week: book fair and reading challenge
data.body: The library is celebrating Reading Week with a book fair, author talk and a reading challenge for all classes. Visit the library during breaks to register.
